text:
Maya Patel: reopening the postmortem follow-up thread — noticed 3 JIRAs left unassigned after Thurs DB incident. can we triage owners and due dates? cc @Ashwin @Jon @Nora
Ashwin Rao: I can take RED-4321 (kv-cache ttl mismatch + config rollout) but need infra access and a pairing window. estimate 2 weeks if no blocking infra work.
Jon Becker: I'll pick up RED-4322 (runbook + small retry-change in client). should be ~3 days.
Nora Li: I was tentatively on RED-4323 but think it belongs with eng-sre (storage side). happy to hand off. who from eng-sre can pick this up?
Sylvia Chen: Product side OK with handoff to eng-sre. SLA impact low but recurring pattern needs tracking. Suggest we add to the recurring-incident epic.
Maya Patel: ok RACI proposal: Ashwin = R, Jon = A for RED-4322, Eng-sre = A for RED-4323, Nora = C, Maya = I. Thoughts?
Jon Becker: small nit — for RED-4322 I'll be A on the runbook task but C on client retry impl (devex will own final QA).
Ashwin Rao: noted. Ashwin -> RED-4321 owner. I'll need a staging window and @triage-bot please attach load logs to the ticket.
triage-bot: attached: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/logs/2024-05-02-db-fault.zip to RED-4321. created link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4321
Maya Patel: listing current action items (quick table):
```
Owner | Ticket | Due | Notes
Ashwin Rao | RED-4321 | 2024-05-28 | infra change + rollout, needs staging
Jon Becker | RED-4322 | 2024-05-21 | runbook + client retry docs
Eng-sre (TBD) | RED-4323 | 2024-05-14 | storage-side mitigation, Nora to handoff
```
Nora Li: tagging @ashwin and @jon — for RED-4323 I'll open a handoff PR with context and the list of repros. will add runbook fragments to the ticket before I drop out.
Maya Patel: can each owner add/update the Jira with: (1) acceptance criteria, (2) rollback plan, (3) test plan? want that by EOD Tues so we can include in weekly ops review.
Jon Becker: will update RED-4322 now. acceptance criteria: runbook covers detection and manual remediation steps; automated alert added to paging.
Ashwin Rao: adding acceptance criteria and staging window. questioning rollout timeline — if eng-sre has capacity we should try to accelerate.
Sylvia Chen: FYI, I'll link these to the customer comms ticket (CS-88) so PM knows expected dates.
Maya Patel: follow-ups: 1) assign eng-sre owner for RED-4323 by Tue noon, 2) owners update Jira with AC/rollback/test by EOD Tue, 3) schedule pairing window for Ashwin + infra.
Nora Li: creating a short checklist in RED-4323 and pinging eng-sre channel.
triage-bot: reminder set: "pm-followup-assignments" in 36h.
Ashwin Rao: quick question on recurring pattern detection — can we add eval to Redwood Optimize to flag similar KV cache mismatches? if yes, I'd like that as a separate ticket (RED-4324).
Maya Patel: good call. I'll create RED-4324 for pattern detection and assign to Research/ML to scope. target: discovery doc next sprint.
Sylvia Chen: thumbs up. this will help reduce repeat remediation load.
Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll consolidate these into one epic and send scrum update. tag me here if you reassign owners.
Jon Becker: noting block: need devex QA env access; @devex-team can you help?
Nora Li: added repro steps to RED-4323 and flagged possible config drift as root cause.
triage-bot: thread archived to epic RED-790.
Maya Patel: closing the thread for now — we'll reopen if owners change or new blockers surface. :white_check_mark:
